Email: corp.relations@bseindia.com 
 
Subject: Conference Call for Investors and Analysts 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosures Requirements) Regulations, 2015, 
we wish to inform you that the Company will organize a conference call for investors and analysts on 
Wednesday, November 4, 2026 at 4:00 PM (IST) to discuss the corporate performance of the second 
quarter and half year ended on September 30, 2026. 
 
The detailed schedule of the conference call is attached herewith for your information. 
 
This information will also be made available on the Company’s website at www.vmart.co.in. 
 
We request you to kindly take the above information on record. 
 
Thanking You, 
 
Yours Truly 
For V-Mart Retail Limited 
 
 
 
 
Megha Tandon 
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer 
 
Encl: as above 
MEGHA 
TANDON
